text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"The Sprinters Stakes.
A highly anticipated showdown of pure speed to decide the truly fastest Umamusume on Earth, but――"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: On top of its usual highlights, this year was packed with far too much material.

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Oh, what's happened!?
One of the favorites, Biko Pegasus, is—

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
She's not here! She hasn't shown up in the paddock!
Where on earth could she have vanished to?!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Huhhh~?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Bono, move aside please.
When you're in front, I can't see anything at all.

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! Looks like she was hiding behind
Hishi Akebono. She's finally shown herself, but...

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: Wh-Wh-What is this...?!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: A difference in build!? Can there really be such a massive gap between fellow Umamusume?

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text: Whoa... That's got to be at least double, no, ten times as much, right?!

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text:
That's going a bit too far.
Though somehow, my sense of perspective really is getting warped...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
To me, having watched her all this time, it was a familiar sight.
But to the fans, it seemed to carry quite an impact.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Ghk, as expected of the Great Leader...! With our strides
being this different, she's pulling away before my eyes...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: I won't lose, though! In that case, I'll take you on with an ultra-high-speed pitch hurricane!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Buono bono bono☆ I'm gonna toss you right into the chanko pot, Biko-chan~!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Huh? The one who wants to be chanko
is me, right? In that case~...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: "I'll turn you into pudding, Biko-chan~. And eat you right up♪"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Hishi Akebono played along with great enthusiasm too.
The paddock was full of excitement.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, Bono. For doing
the hero show with me. But...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
You've really crawled your way all the way to this stage!
I'm... I'm just so overwhelmed with emotion!!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Mm-hmm, Biko-chan.
Me too...!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
"Don't get all teary-eyed mid-race, okay?
Otherwise, Great Monster Buono will take you down!"

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Right on, this is a serious duel!
It's win or be crushed!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Take the power of justice, Bono!
A hero can't afford to lose!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (UOOOOOH!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The venue's excitement rivaled that of a hero show.
And standing right before our eyes was—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A real hero who fought tooth and nail to rise to the top.
Unlike TV, there's no guarantee that justice will prevail.
